text: Cycling is an engaging sport that provides a full body workout while offering a thrilling ride. It involves using a bicycle, typically with two wheels, to move from one place to another. The primary components of a bicycle include the frame, wheels, gears, chain, pedals, and seat. Among these, gears play a crucial role in assisting cyclists to ascend steep hills or maintain a consistent speed during long rides. Wearing a helmet is also an essential safety precaution to protect the head from injuries in case of accidents.
